Every command belongs to one instance. Export a reproducible replay bundle.

    Built from real recovery problems.

    The Windows Guardian helped shape these policies: reach a verified coordinate, prioritize eligible tasks, bound every wait and recover automatic mode. This browser workbench ports those policies into a deterministic simulator.

    What this demo verifies

    State transitions, task isolation, countdowns, resource budgets and recovery decisions. It does not claim to verify game vision, OS input delivery or real combat.
